title: Kavita Reader for iPhone & Android | Sutra
description: Read your Kavita library on iPhone and Android with Sutra. Connect using your personal OPDS URL, then browse DRM-free books and comics.
h1: Read your Kavita library on iPhone and Android
intro: Sutra connects to your self-hosted Kavita library on iOS and Android. Browse and read supported DRM-free EPUB, PDF, CBZ, and MOBI files; free and Pro access depends on format, as described below.
benefits: Connect with Kavita's personal OPDS URL; the URL contains a private API key.
Browse a Kavita catalog and open supported books in Sutra.
Reading progress syncs with Kavita. The exact progress representation can vary by format.
steps: In Kavita, open Settings → 3rd Party Clients (OPDS) and copy your personal OPDS URL.
Keep the URL private: it contains your API key. Do not post it publicly or include it in screenshots.
In Sutra, choose Add Library, paste the URL, and connect.
Open a book from the connected library. Full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI reading require Sutra Pro; EPUB and PDF reading are free.
limitations: Only DRM-free files are supported. CBR archives and DRM-protected Kindle purchases are not supported.
CBZ streaming depends on supported server endpoints and network access; downloading the file is an alternative.
Generic OPDS catalog access should not be confused with Kavita-specific progress synchronization.

faq.q: How do I connect Sutra to Kavita?
faq.a: Copy your personal OPDS URL from Kavita's 3rd Party Clients (OPDS) settings. In Sutra, choose Add Library and paste the URL. Treat it like a password because it contains your API key.

faq.q: Does Sutra sync reading progress with Kavita?
faq.a: Yes. Sutra supports Kavita reading-progress sync. EPUB position is reflowable; page-based formats use their own page progress. Exact behavior can depend on the format.

faq.q: Does Kavita CBZ streaming work on every server?
faq.a: No. Streaming depends on supported server endpoints and network access. If streaming is unavailable, use the download option.

faq.q: Is Kavita support free in Sutra?
faq.a: Kavita library connection is free on iOS and Android. Full CBZ and DRM-free MOBI reading require Sutra Pro; EPUB and PDF reading are free.

faq.q: Can I use Kavita over Tailscale?
faq.a: Sutra can connect when the Kavita server is reachable from the device over your network or VPN. Follow the setup guidance for your server and keep its OPDS key private.
